units.source_text: ……我感受到感情的和谐和幸福。

en.t: ...I felt a harmony of feeling and happiness.

units.source_text: 我永远忘不了这时刻所看到的金阁的情景，这是不足为奇的。

en.t: It is no wonder that I can never forget the sight of the Golden Pavilion as I saw it at that moment.

units.source_text: 我们两人从正打瞌腆的传达室老头的跟前走过，沿着土墙急步经过渺无人影的路，来到了金阁的前面。

en.t: The two of us walked past the old man in the reception room, who was just dozing off, hurried along the deserted road beside the earthen wall, and came to the front of the Golden Pavilion.
